requirements.general_text: Any of These: A minimum of a second-class Honours degree or an equivalent academic qualification in a related subject area. For postgraduate conversion courses, non-related degrees will be considered. Corporate (or chartered) membership of relevant professional institutions will also be considered. Non-related degrees will be considered on an individual basis based on CV and work experience. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 5.5. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.0 requirement.
